description: One Poseidon plugin enabled for the session: its skills directory handed over with skills/extraRoots/set, its HTTP MCP server (pointed at a port nothing listens on) in thread/start's config as one dotted mcp_servers key, beside poseidon's. The turn references the plugin's scratch-word skill, whose SKILL.md names the word: the skill found in skills/list and attached as a skill input; every card is allowed once.
prompts: Reply with the scratch word only.
